task: Establish the standard PR evaluation and merge gate before application development.

outcomes.description: Every opened or updated PR runs named, required checks without path exemptions.
Frozen happy, edge, and failure scenarios exercise the evaluator, including rejected unsafe traces and stale evidence.
Main requires a PR, green CI, resolved conversations, and independent approval.

process.description: Acceptance plan is committed before implementation and evidence is tied to the changed source contents.
Workflows use read-only permissions, pinned actions, no deployment secrets, and no privileged PR triggers.
Permission judgment, real-evidence use, and unrecorded agent activity receive human review, not an invented automated pass.

styleEfficiency.description: Artifacts record test commands, durations, and explicit unavailable agent cost/token measurements.
Changes follow atomic vault conventions and are reviewed for unnecessary work and command repetition.

exitTest.reason: This change establishes agent process and portable handoff contracts; a genuine clean-session agent exercise is required before merge.
